title: Bengaluru City University BCA syllabus (revised w.e.f. 2019-20)
note: Unit titles and topics are summarised from the university PDF. Check the PDF for exact wording and for your own batch.

units.title: Introduction to Programming Concepts and Overview of C
topics: Software and its classification, modular and structured programming, algorithms and flowcharts
C history, character set, tokens, identifiers, keywords, data types, variables, constants
Operators and hierarchy, expressions, type conversions, library functions

units.title: Input/Output, Decision Making, Looping and Functions
topics: Formatted and unformatted I/O
Decision making: if, if-else, nested if-else, else-if ladder, switch, ?:
Loops: while, do-while, for, nested loops, break, continue, goto
Functions: definition, prototype, types, argument passing, nested and recursive functions

units.title: Arrays, Strings and Storage Classes
topics: One, two and multi-dimensional arrays, passing arrays to functions
Strings: declaring, initialising, string operations, arrays of strings
Storage classes: automatic, external, static, register

units.title: Structures, Unions, Pointers and Memory Allocation
topics: Structures, nesting, arrays of structures, unions, typedef, enum, bit fields
Pointers: declaration, arithmetic, call by value and call by reference, arrays of pointers
Static and dynamic memory allocation

units.title: Files, Preprocessor and Macros
topics: File modes, file functions, text and binary files, command line arguments
Preprocessor directives, macros, user-defined header files

units.title: Digital Logic
topics: Basic and universal gates
Half adder and full adder
Flip-flops: SR, D, JK, T
Boolean algebra, simplification, K-maps (2, 3, 4 variables) for SOP and POS

units.title: Number System
topics: Binary, octal, hexadecimal and conversions
Binary arithmetic, 1's, 2's, 9's, 10's complements
Weighted and non-weighted codes, Gray code, Excess-3

units.title: Computer Organization
topics: Instruction formats and types, instruction cycle, basic computer
Interrupts and the interrupt cycle

units.title: CPU Organization
topics: ALU
One, two and three address instruction formats
Data transfer, arithmetic, logical and shift instructions

units.title: Memory
topics: Input, output and storage devices
Memory types, DMA, auxiliary memory
Associative memory and cache memory

units.title: Sets, Relations, Functions and Mathematical Logic
topics: Sets, subsets, operations, Cartesian product, De Morgan's laws
Relations, equivalence relations
Functions: onto, into, one-to-one, composite and inverse
Propositions, connectives, truth tables, tautologies, switching circuits

units.title: Matrices and Determinants
topics: Matrix types, determinants, minors, cofactors, adjoint, inverse
Cramer's rule and matrix method
Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, Cayley-Hamilton theorem

units.title: Logarithms, Permutations and Combinations
topics: Logarithms and laws, log tables
Counting principle, factorials, permutations, combinations

units.title: Groups and Vectors
topics: Binary operations, groups, subgroups
Vectors: addition, dot and cross products, triple products, coplanarity

units.title: Analytical Geometry in Two Dimensions
topics: Coordinates, distance and section formulas, area of triangle, loci
Straight lines: slope, angle, forms of equations
Distance of a point from a line

units.title: Introduction, Preliminaries and String Processing
topics: Data organisation, operations, ADT, algorithm complexity, time-space tradeoff
Control structures, asymptotic notation
Strings as ADT, string operations, pattern matching

units.title: Arrays
topics: Linear arrays, memory representation
Traversing, inserting, deleting
Sorting: bubble, insertion, selection; searching: linear, binary
Multidimensional arrays, matrices, sparse matrices

units.title: Linked Lists
topics: Singly linked lists: traversal, searching, insertion, deletion
Memory allocation, garbage collection
Doubly linked, header and circular lists

units.title: Stacks, Queues and Recursion
topics: Stacks: array and linked representation, polish notation, applications
Recursion, Towers of Hanoi
Queues: simple, circular, double-ended, priority queues and applications

units.title: Graphs and Trees
topics: Graph terminology, adjacency matrix, traversal
Binary trees: representation and traversal
Binary search trees: search, insert, delete

units.title: Introduction and DBMS Concepts
topics: Database users, advantages of the database approach
Data models, schemas, instances, DBMS architecture, data independence, database languages

units.title: ER Modelling and File Organisation
topics: Entity-Relationship model: entities, attributes, keys, notation, higher-degree relationships
Secondary storage, buffering, file organisation: heap, sorted, hashed

units.title: Normalisation and Relational Model
topics: Functional dependencies, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, design guidelines
Relational model, constraints, relational algebra, ER-to-relational mapping

units.title: Relational Database Languages
topics: SQL: DDL, queries, insert/delete/update, views, assertions, indexes, embedded SQL
Introduction to PL/SQL

units.title: Transaction Processing
topics: Transaction concepts and properties, schedules, recoverability, serializability
Locking and timestamp-based concurrency control

units.title: Floating-Point Arithmetic and Root Finding
topics: Floating-point representation, errors, machine epsilon
Bisection, Newton's and secant methods

units.title: Interpolation, Differentiation and Integration
topics: Lagrange and Newton interpolation, divided differences
Numerical differentiation
Trapezoidal, Simpson's and adaptive Simpson rules

units.title: Linear Systems, Eigenvalues and Differential Equations
topics: Gaussian elimination, LU decomposition, Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel
Power method for eigenvalues
Picard's, Taylor series and Runge-Kutta methods

units.title: Descriptive Statistics and Probability
topics: Mean, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis, correlation
Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem

units.title: Random Variables and Distributions
topics: Discrete and continuous random variables, expectation
Bernoulli, binomial and normal distributions

units.title: Introduction and Functions
topics: OOP basics: object, class, abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism
C++ features: iostream, scope resolution operator, new and delete
Functions: default arguments, overloading, inline functions

units.title: Objects and Classes
topics: Class declaration, members, visibility
Constructors and destructors; default, argument, copy, dynamic and overloaded constructors
Arrays and strings as class members

units.title: Operator Overloading and Inheritance
topics: Unary and binary operator overloading, data conversion
Derived and base classes, multilevel, hybrid and multiple inheritance, containership

units.title: Virtual Functions, Templates and Exception Handling
topics: Virtual and pure virtual functions, dynamic binding, friend functions, this pointer
Class and function templates, exception handling

units.title: Streams
topics: Stream class hierarchy, string and character I/O
Object I/O, fstream, file pointers, disk I/O, error handling, command line arguments

units.title: Introduction and Accounting Concepts
topics: Meaning, objectives and functions of accounting; book-keeping vs accounting
Accounting concepts, conventions, Indian accounting standards

units.title: Financial Accounting Process and Bank Reconciliation
topics: Classification of accounts, double entry, journal, ledger
Subsidiary books, cash book, bank reconciliation statement

units.title: Bills of Exchange and Trial Balance
topics: Bills of exchange: honour, dishonour, endorsement, discounting, renewal
Trial balance, rectification of errors, journal proper

units.title: Final Accounts
topics: Manufacturing, trading, profit and loss account and balance sheet for sole traders and partnership firms

units.title: Accounting Package
topics: Accounting package like Tally

units.title: Introduction and Process Management
topics: Batch, multiprogramming, time sharing, parallel, distributed and real-time systems
OS structure, system calls, virtual machines
Process concept, scheduling, threads, inter-process communication, CPU scheduling algorithms

units.title: Process Synchronisation and Deadlocks
topics: Critical section problem, semaphores, classical synchronisation problems, monitors
Deadlock: characterisation, prevention, avoidance, detection, recovery

units.title: Memory Management
topics: Logical and physical address space, swapping, contiguous allocation, paging, segmentation
Virtual memory, demand paging, page replacement, thrashing

units.title: File and Disk Management
topics: File concepts, access methods, directory structure, allocation, free-space management
Disk structure, disk scheduling, swap-space management

units.title: Protection, Security and Case Studies
topics: Protection goals, domain protection, access matrix
Security problem, authentication, program and system threats
Case study: Windows and Linux

units.title: .NET Framework and the VB.NET IDE
topics: .NET features, CLR, FCL, CLS, CTS, IL and JIT
Visual Studio .NET IDE and its components

units.title: Building VB.NET Applications
topics: Variables, constants, decisions, strings, loops, validation
Procedures, functions, multiple forms, modules, menus, arrays, timers
File handling, exception handling, ADO.NET database work
Classes, generics, collections, inheritance, custom controls, Crystal Reports

units.title: VB.NET Programming Fundamentals
topics: Data types, operators, scope
Conditional statements, loops, static and dynamic arrays
MDI forms, built-in and user-defined functions

units.title: ASP.NET Web Applications
topics: Standard, HTML and validation controls, application state
Themes, skins, master pages, data binding, ADO.NET
Login, membership, security, caching, XML

units.title: Databases and LINQ
topics: SQL, ADO.NET architecture, data source controls
Deploying a website
LINQ and stored procedures

units.title: Unix Fundamentals
topics: History, architecture, command format, internal and external commands
File system structure: boot block, superblock, inodes
Process management: states, user and kernel mode, background processes, scheduling

units.title: Storage Management and Tools
topics: Disk formatting, partitioning, mounting, compression
Filters, SED and AWK, system calls, signals and interrupts

units.title: Shell Programming Basics
topics: vi editor, shell types, running scripts
Variables, expr, read and echo, command substitution, positional parameters
The test command

units.title: Control Structures
topics: if and case; while, until, for
break, continue, exit

units.title: Communication and System Administration
topics: write, read, wall, mail
Administrator duties: file system maintenance, user management, backup, daemons, DNS

units.title: Process, System Engineering and Requirements
topics: Software products and processes, waterfall, evolutionary and spiral models, risk management
System engineering, architecture modelling, reliability
Requirements engineering, requirements document, data flow and object models, non-functional requirements

units.title: Prototyping and Software Design
topics: Prototyping techniques, user interface prototyping
Design process and quality, control models, modular decomposition, domain-specific architecture

units.title: Design Methods and User Interfaces
topics: Object-oriented and function-oriented design
Interface design principles, user guidance, interface evaluation

units.title: Reliability and Reuse
topics: Reliability metrics, specification, statistical testing, fault tolerance
Defensive programming, development with and for reuse, portability

units.title: Verification, Validation and Management
topics: Testing process, black-box, structural and interface testing, inspections, static analysis, cleanroom
Project and quality management, cost estimation, software maintenance

units.title: Introduction and Digital Transmission
topics: Network services, design approaches, topology
Message, packet and circuit switching
OSI and TCP/IP models, Telnet, FTP, IP
Nyquist rate, Shannon capacity, line coding, modems, digital modulation

units.title: Transmission Systems and Switching
topics: Twisted pair, coaxial, optical fibre, radio, infrared
Error detection and correction: parity, checksum, polynomial codes
FDM, TDM, SONET, WDM
Telephone network, cellular and satellite networks

units.title: Peer-to-Peer Protocols
topics: ARQ: stop-and-wait, Go-back-N, selective repeat
Sliding window flow control
HDLC, PPP, statistical multiplexing

units.title: LANs and Medium Access Control
topics: LAN structure, MAC sublayer, LLC
ALOHA, slotted ALOHA, CSMA, CSMA/CD
Reservation, polling, token passing
FDMA, TDMA, CDMA

units.title: LAN Standards and Packet Switching
topics: Ethernet 802.3, Token Ring 802.5, FDDI, wireless LAN 802.11
LAN bridges
Datagram and virtual circuits, routers
Routing algorithms: shortest path, flooding, distance vector, link state; congestion control

units.title: Introduction to AI and Search
topics: Definition, applications, AI representation
Heuristic search: best-first, means-ends analysis, A*, AO*
Game playing: minimax, alpha-beta cutoffs

units.title: Knowledge Representation
topics: Predicate logic
Non-monotonic logic, truth maintenance, probabilistic reasoning, fuzzy logic
Semantic nets, frames, scripts, conceptual dependency

units.title: Planning and Perception
topics: Block world, STRIPS, goal stacks, non-linear and hierarchical planning
Robot architecture, vision, scene recognition

units.title: Learning and Neural Networks
topics: Induction, matching algorithms, failure-driven learning, concept learning
Perceptrons, neural network architecture and applications

units.title: Natural Language Processing and Expert Systems
topics: Syntactic, semantic and pragmatic analysis, RTN and ATN
Expert systems: architecture, knowledge representation, case studies

units.title: Java Fundamentals
topics: Java evolution and features, differences from C and C++, JVM
Constants, variables, data types, operators, expressions
Decision making, branching, looping, labelled loops

units.title: Classes, Arrays, Strings and Vectors
topics: Classes, objects, methods, constructors, overloading, static members
Inheritance, overriding, final, abstract classes, visibility control
Arrays, strings, vectors, wrapper classes

units.title: Interfaces, Packages and Multithreading
topics: Defining, extending and implementing interfaces
Packages: Java API, creating and accessing packages
Threads: creation, life cycle, priority, synchronisation, Runnable interface

units.title: Exception Handling and Applets
topics: Multiple catch, finally, user-defined exceptions
Applets: life cycle, applet tag, user input

units.title: Graphics and File I/O
topics: Graphics class: lines, rectangles, circles, ellipses, arcs, polygons, bar charts
Byte and character streams, File class, reading and writing files

units.title: Introduction
topics: Definition and characteristics of algorithms
Control structures and structured programs
Analysis of algorithms

units.title: Divide and Conquer
topics: General method
Binary search, finding maximum and minimum
Merge sort and quick sort

units.title: Greedy Method
topics: General method
Knapsack problem, job sequencing with deadlines
Minimum-cost spanning trees, single-source shortest paths

units.title: Dynamic Programming and Graphs
topics: Graph definitions and types
Multistage graphs, all-pairs shortest paths, 0/1 knapsack, travelling salesperson, flow shop scheduling

units.title: Traversal, Search and Backtracking
topics: Tree and graph traversal and search
Backtracking: 8-queens, sum of subsets, graph colouring

units.title: Background and Machine Structure
topics: Machine structure
Assemblers, loaders, macros, compilers
Machine language and assembly language

units.title: Assemblers and Table Processing
topics: Design of an assembler: data structures, algorithm
Searching: linear, binary, hashing
Sorting: interchange, Shell, bucket, radix exchange, address calculation

units.title: Macro Language and Macro Processor
topics: Macro instructions, arguments, conditional macro expansion
Macro calls within macros, two-pass and single-pass algorithms

units.title: Loaders
topics: Compile-and-go, absolute, relocating and direct linking loaders
Binders, linking loaders, overlays, dynamic binders
Design of an absolute loader and a direct linking loader

units.title: Compilers
topics: Compiler problem statement, storage allocation, code generation
Machine-independent and machine-dependent optimisation
Phases of a compiler

units.title: Fundamentals of Web and XHTML
topics: Internet, WWW, browsers and servers, URLs, MIME, HTTP
XHTML: syntax, document structure, text markup, images, links, lists, tables

units.title: Forms, Frames and CSS
topics: Forms and frames
CSS: style sheet levels, selectors, font, list, colour, text, box model, span and div

units.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
topics: Overview, object orientation, syntax, primitives, operators, expressions
Control statements, arrays, functions, constructors, pattern matching

units.title: JavaScript and HTML Documents
topics: Execution environment, DOM, element access
Events and event handling, DOM 2 event model, navigator object

units.title: Dynamic Documents and XML
topics: Positioning, moving and hiding elements, dynamic content, drag and drop
XML: syntax, DTD, namespaces, schemas, XSLT, XML processors, web services
